title: Dihya (al-Kahina)
summary: Later accounts describe Dihya, called al-Kahina, as a Berber leader centred on the Aurès Mountains of present-day Algeria who defeated the army of the Arab commander Hasan ibn al-Numan and was later killed in battle. Sources disagree on dates: the victory is put at 692 or 696, her death at 698, 701 or 702. Her chroniclers are described as steeped in legend.

uncertainty.note: Sources disagree: victory 692 (Georgetown) or 696 (Medievalists.net); death 698 or 702 (Georgetown) or 701 (Medievalists.net). The span covers the stated range.
